newsitems.contents:
[p]Patch 7.41d is out now and you can check out the patch notes [url="https://www.dota2.com/patches/7.41d"]here[/url].[/p]

In addition, we've recently addressed the following issues:
[list]
[*] Fixed Greevils not spawning their equipped effects
[*] Fixed Earthshaker's Planetfall Arcana not tracking combos and combo damage properly
[*] Fixed right click on Dota Labs Overlay Map not working when "Auto-Repeat Right Mouse" is enabled
[*] Fixed Bottle with a stored Rune being able to be moved in and out of the backpack
[*] Fixed Harmonizer not considering abilities with charges on cooldown
[*] Fixed Elder Titan's Astral Spirit's movement speed not taking Wind Lace into account
[*] Fixed Elder Titan's Echo Stomp shard not swapping places with Astral Spirit if he is being moved by another ability when the stomp goes off
[*] Fixed Invoker not receiving an Aghanim's Blessing from Alchemist if Alchemist casts Aghanim's Scepter on Invoker when his main inventory is full but the backpack had space
[*] Fixed Alchemist being able to repeatedly give Invoker Aghanim's Blessings if Invoker hasn't chosen his Aghanim's Scepter upgrade
[*] Fixed Invoker not correctly being refunded for his Aghanim's Blessing if Invoker has not selected an Aghanim's Scepter upgrade and Alchemist casts Aghanim's Scepter on him
[*] Fixed Spirit Bear's permanently consumed items not counting towards Lone Druid's net worth
[*] Fixed Spirit Breaker permanently changing teams when he reflects Venomancer's Noxious Plague with Lotus Orb and then casts Planar Pocket on Venomancer before Noxious Plague spreads, then after it spreads to a neutral creep Venomancer uses Helm of the Dominator on that creep
[*] Fixed Venomancer being able to Transmute Spirit Breaker with Hand of Midas through the same process
[*] Fixed Wraith King's Vampiric Spirit not turning Wraith King into a wraith if he levels up at the same time as dying
[*] Ability Draft: Fixed Forge Spirit starting at too high a level
[*] Ability Draft: Fixed Brewmaster's old Aghanim's Scepter being available
[/list]

newsitems.title: 2026 PGS 6: Who will be the final winner?
newsitems.author: JBowlerr
newsitems.contents:
[p][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260604/gkOC94XN.png" style="border-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0px 1px; user-select: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/b][/p][p][/p][p]The first half of the 2026 PGS is already nearing its end. With various teams taking turns claiming the championship, I’d like to introduce three teams considered the absolute strongest title contenders. Let's take a clear look at each team's unique traits, strengths, and weaknesses.[/p][p][/p][p][b][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260604/FbtZ2p21.jpg" style="border-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0px 1px; user-select: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/b][/p][p][b]\[The God of War / Natus Vincere][/b][/p][p]"Born to Win." Living up to their name, Natus Vincere (NAVI) is a team that fears no fight. They don't mind disadvantageous terrain or setups; they overcome it all through sheer combat, eventually pulling off victories that give viewers an electrifying thrill. Led by their ace Hakatory, the roster includes boost1k- (who debuted last year and became Europe's rising star), spyrro (a foundational veteran of PUBG esports), and Feyerist (handling team coordination and backup). Together, they are making massive waves in the 2026 PUBG esports scene.[/p][p]There are countless moments that highlight NAVI's overwhelming combat prowess, but the most iconic would be 2026 PGS 2, where they pulled off a dramatic comeback championship from the brink. The back-to-back Chicken Dinners in Match 9 (Taego) and Match 10 (Miramar) are prime examples of them winning through absolute dominance. In Match 9 on Taego, they crushed a full-squad Anyone's Legend (AL) with just three players. In the final Match 10 on Miramar, despite a 13-point deficit behind the frontrunner AL, they once again used just three players to wipe out other teams, taking an 18-kill Chicken Dinner and carving out a historic comeback victory themselves.[/p][p]This team's strength is clear-cut: their gunplay is simply unbelievable. In terms of pure combat ability, it's safe to say almost no one can match their main roster. Hakatory, mentioned earlier, is the team's absolute core. To put it simply, even Twisted Minds' xmpl, who was revered by all players until '25, has to take a backseat to Hakatory considering recent stats. He secured a staggering 9 Man of the Match titles across the '26 PGS events and even took the Kill Leader title in PGS 5, building an untouchable legacy.[/p][p]Their team stats are just as stellar. Usually, teams that hit over 900 DPM (Damage Per Match) are the ones lifting the trophies. Over 45 matches in the '26 PGS Final Stage, NAVI recorded 45,323 total damage, hitting a DPM of 1,007. While damage isn't always the most highlighted metric, NAVI's true value shines in how they consistently stack damage to pry open opportunities.[/p][p]Most engagements start with Hakatory opening fire. From there, NAVI's primary win condition is leveraging numerical advantages to crush the opposition. Hakatory's combat ability is so overwhelming that he can often take down 2 to 3 players in a row by himself. But that's also their biggest double-edged sword: if Hakatory is picked off early, their win rate isn't great. Recently, however, spyrro and boost1k- have been putting up such aggressive performances that they're offsetting that weakness, making the team an even more terrifying unit.[/p][p]The moment you engage this team, you have to fight with the mindset of risking a full wipe. They are undoubtedly the most dreaded team to face. Your only real chance is to focus fire the exact moment they take damage. If you're aiming for the championship, you absolutely cannot miss the split second NAVI wavers. But what if NAVI stays on their feet until the very end? Well, quietly dropping a frag grenade at your own feet might be one way out.[/p][p][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260604/6jA1Gwje.jpg" style="border-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0px 1px; user-select: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][p][b]\[The Master of Rotation / Virtus.pro][/b][/p][p]If I had to pick just one team that best understands the fundamental rules of PUBG, I would choose this team without hesitation. Clean, flawless plays, refreshing survival strategies tailored to every situation, rotations that erase the opponents' options one by one, and a display of maximum capacity in everything needed to survive. That is Virtu[u][url="http://virtus.pro/"]s.pro(VP).[/url][/u][/p][p]Of course, VP wasn't perfect from the start. Before winning 26 PGS 3, they tasted the bitterness of consecutive Final Stage eliminations in PGS 1 and 2. However, they consistently stacked data to figure out other teams' paths. They developed ways to stabilize their roster and perfected their "first aid kit" strategy for when their squad was crippled, pushing their survival time to the extreme limit. The average survival time for a tournament-winning team is usually around 24 minutes, but across 35 matches, VP recorded a whopping 25 minutes and 56 seconds per match.[/p][p]The Taego match that epitomizes VP's survival drama shows just how meticulous and calculating this team is. With the final circle ending inside a building, they recognized their positional disadvantage against 4AM, who had already taken the roof. Deciding they couldn't win a head-on fight, they prepared Level 3 and 2 Jammer Packs. Tanking massive Blue Zone damage and outlasting everyone to take the Chicken Dinner was a scene that showcased the very essence of PUBG.[/p][p]On top of that, VP is the most strategic user of Gliders among international teams. The hardest part for edge teams rotating inward is spotting hidden ambushes. VP solves this by using Gliders to scout for ambushes before moving in, maximizing their squad's preservation. They were also the first team to attempt a Glider drop strategy in an international tournament. Although they lost that Rondo match, it was a moment that showed VP's brilliant quick-thinking and creativity.[/p][p]Add to that their decision-making ability to instantly lock down the battlefield and cut off other teams' options. A prime example is the Miramar match in PGS 5 Final Stage D1 M2. They completely shut down the entry routes of T1 and Petrichor Road pushing up from the south, simultaneously ruining 4AM's plans to third-party the fight, resulting in a flawless Chicken Dinner. VP doesn't just sit and wait for the circle; they have the ability to proactively design the situation.[/p][p]I've focused heavily on their survival and strategy, but does that mean they lack firepower? During their 26 PGS 3 championship run, across 15 matches, they averaged 5.9 kills per match, 16,993 total damage, and a DPM of 1,132. By bringing renowned fighting teams to their knees, they proved their combat prowess is entirely intact. While they prefer simple, practical techniques in fights, they also show trendy mechanics depending on the situation, proving their individual skills are highly solid.[/p][p]Armed with diverse strategies and judgments to outlive anyone, VP will remain a complex puzzle in the minds of every participating team. While other teams are busy trying to solve that puzzle, VP will only grow more solid. They might just be the first to lift their second PGS trophy.[img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20260604/X0zrIbnE.jpg" style="border-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0px 1px; user-select: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][b]
\[The Standard / 17Gaming][/b][/p][p]Everyone expected them to fail under those circumstances. Many said it was impossible because their core roster couldn't play together. A coach in his forties had to inevitably fill the void, and just as many predicted, the team was pushed to the absolute edge in the Survival Stage.[/p][p]But defying concerns, Coach Akuma filled the gap to secure a ticket to the Final Stage, and once their starting players returned for the finals, they went all the way to win 26 PGS 5. This is the story of China's PUBG powerhouse, 17Gaming.[/p][p]Hearing just the intro might make it sound like a dramatic movie, but if you look closely at the matches, 17Gaming didn't really change much. They simply moved to good positions at the right times, maintained the spots they usually favored but with added stability, and flawlessly demonstrated their world-class grenade usage. If there was a difference, it was maybe using a bit more smokes than usual. 17Gaming simply plays the game by the book.[/p][p]17Gaming doesn't use dramatic fights like NAVI or eccentric strategies like VP, but they always make the best possible move in every situation. Unexpected variables are bound to happen in this game, and maintaining cold logic through all of it is not easy. But China's greatest mastermind, Lilghost, makes composed yet profound decisions.[/p][p]The Rondo match in Final Stage D1 M4 serves as a perfect example. A Test Track circle popped, setting up a classic do-or-die scenario. 17 Gaming constantly looked for gaps to push inward while swatting away teams on the edge. They meticulously checked the kill feed, attempting entry based entirely on hard information.[/p][p]When MiTH, who was playing the outer fields, got wiped while forcing a push onto NAVI's in-circle compound, NAVI also failed to keep their squad intact. 17Gaming, who had been eyeing that exact spot, walked right in without shedding a drop of blood. Even DNS, who held a favorable late-game circle, saw their solid defensive line crumble from a single Lilghost frag grenade. 17Gaming followed up with continuous nades to wipe DNS, fended off all remaining teams, and took the Chicken Dinner.[/p][p]Usually, teams that deal over 17 damage per grenade get good results in tournaments. Across 30 Final Stage matches, 17Gaming threw 309 frag grenades, dealing a total of 5,828 damage. Doing the math, that’s an average of 18.86 damage per nade. Such incredible stats are partly due to the players' mechanical skill, but mostly because the shot-calling on exactly where to focus those throws is crystal clear.[/p][p]Furthermore, their play of holding the edge, burning as much time as possible, and watching for the perfect spot before moving in has become noticeably smoother than in the past. Built on that strategy, they managed to grab two Chicken Dinners on Taego in a single day. At the center of that secret was the rediscovery of the Porter, a vehicle rarely utilized on Taego.[/p][p]The Porter's cargo capacity is 400. Even if you only packed smoke grenades (weight 14), you could fit a whopping 28 of them. Not only that, but when you load items into the trunk, physical boxes actually appear in the back, providing cover from bullets. Of course, it's hard to drive and keeping the tires safe is tough, but in this PGS 5, 17Gaming successfully loaded the Porter with various supplies and utilized it until the very end of their Taego matches.[/p][p]The players' individual forms are also top-tier. Xwudd, the best gunner in the mid-range, along with tiantian and Wenbo—newly acquired from CTG this year—blended into the team so naturally it feels like they’ve always been there. With everyone's mechanics peaking, it looks incredibly difficult for anyone to gain the upper hand against 17 Gaming. The standard does not waver easily.[/p][p][b]Conclusion[/b][/p][p]If you've read this far, one question probably comes to mind.[/p][p]So, who’s going to win?[/p][p]There are no absolutes in PUBG. Predictions can always miss the mark, and new variables can always emerge. Nevertheless, at this very moment, I pick Natus Vincere, Virtus.pro, and 17Gaming as the absolute strongest contenders.[/p][p]Data doesn't lie. The results and metrics built up across countless matches ultimately prove who the strong teams are. And if the current momentum holds, it’s highly likely that the PGS 6 trophy will end up in the arms of one of these three teams.[/p][p]Whether my prediction hits the mark... we'll ultimately find the answer on the battlegrounds of PGS 6.[/p][p]- Jisooboy[/p]

newsitems.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and Warzone - Season 04
newsitems.author: ATVI_Dov
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2cfac2ca7800e91b1d42af7115e70f83bec622e1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Yours for the Taking: Black Ops Season 04 is Here![/u][/h2][p] [/p][h3]The Story So Far[/h3][p] [/p][p]After David Mason is captured by The Guild and Specter Two goes on the offense with their own man on the inside, Karma's Guild-killing virus is finally ready to deploy... but Dorne has one last card to play. A collision of forces at JSOC's secret jungle hideout will determine the shape of the future.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Season 04 Roadmap[/h3][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5f2ddd972b454b36a052faf67b8076914fbe6310.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Across [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i], Season 04 introduces another massive season of content. Take on Operation Wall Breaker in Endgame, deploy across five new and remastered Multiplayer Maps, hail the return of Fortune’s Keep, fight off the horde in the new Rogue Run game mode set on Ashes of the Damned in Zombies, and much more![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="59AgHBmGozI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Season 04 is yours for the taking. Join the action in this substantial update packed with free and premium content arriving when [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Season 04 goes live on Thursday, June 4th at 9AM PT across all platforms.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h2][u]Endgame Content[/u][/h2][p] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]FREE TO PLAY: ENDGAME CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Expanded Operations:[/b] At the start of the season, The Guild strikes back in Operation Wall Breaker, introducing new challenges and rewards alongside the deadly Command Killer Glitch Fracture. In the Mid-Season, keep up the fight in Operation King Killer.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Operator Prestige: [/b]Achieve new milestones in Endgame with the introduction of Operator Prestige. Hit max Combat Rating and Prestige to unlock even more ways to build your playstyle, including an extra Exotic slot, extra Nightmare slot, and a fourth Skill Track![/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Skill Track, Two Abilities:[/b] Make mincemeat out of your foes with the addition of the Death Machine Major Ability. In the Mid-Season, get access to the new Guardian Skill Track and send targets over the edge with the Psych Grenade Minor Ability.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Act III: Operation Wall Breaker (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d5d75fe1f40689821b2b911b2de669999e716dc1.jpg"][/img] [/p][p][i]The Guild strikes back: a Command Node is preventing Karma’s virus from attacking their network. Scour Avalon for enough Mapping Data to locate the Node and take it down.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]The push to infiltrate The Guild’s network has hit a snag, and unless Karma and her allies can find their way past the company firewall, their plans will have been in vain.[/p][p] [/p][p]In Season 04, players must return to Avalon to find the weak link in Guild security, starting with the search for the region’s hidden network hub. Find it, breach the firewall, and gain the permissions needed to successfully access the command center node.[/p][p] [/p][p]Once you’ve breached the command node, it’s time to crack The Guild’s operations wide open. Enter the ensuing Command Killer Glitch Fracture and complete the mission.[/p][p] [/p][p]Defeat the Glitch Boss, Earn Rewards[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1ea98b1519aa15487ab3ba69b1b1bfd5a3cee8f9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Operators who progress through the steps in Act III will earn a bounty of in-game rewards, all while empowering your Operator for the challenges ahead. In the final phase, locate the Command Killer Glitch Fracture to battle through relentless waves of enemies in Nightmare Difficulty.[/p][p] [/p][p]Defeat the Command Killer Glitch Boss with 50/50, Razor, or Faulkner to earn their unique “Shatter Shock” Operator Skins.[/p][p] [/p][p]Act III Completion Rewards: [/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]Earn 1 “Shatter Shock” Operator Skin to earn the “Decay” Weapon Camo.[/p][/*][*][p]Earn all 3 “Shatter Shock” Operator Skins to access the “Visitors” Animated Weapon Camo.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Operation Wall Breaker Rewards[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/df0ca290cb02b4fc40ba0a784047b562201959d5.jpg"][/img] [/p][list][*][p]“Brain Freeze” Weapon Charm and 1,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Restore Token and 1,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Player XP Token and 1,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Splitter” Emblem and 2,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Battle Pass XP Token and 2,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Frost Beast” Large Decal and 2,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Weapon XP Token and 5,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Fractal Cry” Loading Screen and 5,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Forehead Slap” Emote and 5,000 XP[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Cold Shoulder” Weapon Blueprint, “Terms of Service” Animated Calling Card, and 7,500 XP[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]More in the Mid-Season[/p][p] [/p][p]There’s no time to let up while The Guild is fighting this hard to maintain their dominance in Avalon. In the Mid-Season, get ready to take on Act IV: Operation King Killer, introducing new challenges and rewards. Get more intel when the Season 04 Reloaded blog arrives in the lead up to the Mid-Season.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Introducing Operator Prestige (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/54bbdfc86f184154cbde5013871d0b6868e606c9.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]Starting with Season 04, Endgame Operators with a maxed-out Combat Rating (CR) will gain the option to enter Operator Prestige 1, starting a whole new leveling journey in exchange for greater power. Entering Prestige discards all equipped Skills, resets the Operator’s CR, discards equipped Field Acquisitions, and resets Loadout weapons to their base rarity.[/p][p] [/p][p]From this fresh state, redeploy to Avalon and start upping your CR again. With each Prestige, your Operator will earn access to additional skillsets, including:[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Prestige 1: [/b]Extra Exotic Skill Slot[/p][p][b]Prestige 2: [/b]Extra Nightmare Skill Slot[/p][p][b]Prestige 3: [/b]Equip a 4th Skill Track[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h3]Guardian Skill Track, Two New Abilities[/h3][p] [/p][p]At launch, unleash fury on your enemies as the devastating Death Machine joins the list of available Major Abilities. In the Mid-Season, keep your armor and ammo stocked with the new Guardian Skill Track and send foes into a psychotic spiral with the addition of the Psych Grenade Minor Ability.[/p][p] [/p][p]Skill Track: Guardian (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Stand your ground and turn pressure into power. The Guardian skill track makes you a frontline anchor, shrugging off damage, punishing attackers, and sustaining both yourself and your squad. With stronger defenses, better resource drops, and proximity-based revives, Guardians do not just survive the fight, they control it.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Payback: [/b]Enemies that damage the player receive damage themselves.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Battle Cache: [/b]Increased chance to spawn an Ammo/Armor Resupply pack when eliminating an enemy.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Power Tap: [/b]Picking up Ammo/Armor Resupply packs also grants Equipment recharge.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Fortified: [/b]Reduce incoming damage for every currently equipped plate. The more plates equipped, the bigger the damage reduction.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Iron Grip: [/b]Reduce hip fire bullet spread and reduce flinch when getting hit.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Rescue Pulse: [/b]If allies are downed, the player can revive them just by being near them. If the player goes down, other players can revive them just by being nearby.[/p][p] [/p][p]New Major Ability: Death Machine (Launch)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c4e3524cc1797ee944ea5dac20ecfb501217e187.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Deadly machine gun. High damage per shot and large magazine capacity.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p]New Minor Ability: Psych Grenade (Mid-Season)[/p][p] [/p][p][i]Explodes on impact, releasing a lingering cloud of hallucinogenic gas that brain-rots enemies.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Endgame's free-to-play period will extend to the end of Season 05, so bring your friends and jump into all the new content waiting for you in Avalon! If you haven't tried Endgame yet, now's the perfect time to start earning all the Weapon Camos, Operator Skins, and additional rewards the mode has to offer.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Black Ops 7: Multiplayer Content[/u][/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Maps:[/b] At launch, descend into a Guild procedure where the patient’s unstable mind reshapes the map in Liminal, battle within a Japanese game show in Primetime, and watch your step on the remastered Vertigo. In the Mid-Season, play through a map of traps in the new Zenith and activate a rocket on the remastered Launch.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Multiplayer Modes:[/b] Wind back the clock with Black Ops Classic, wield sleek weapons in Blueprint Gun Game, and adapt to your given Loadout in 6v6 Gunfight. Later in the season, cycle through weapons in Team Blueprint Sharpshooter and ditch the ranged weapons in Knife Fight.   [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Additional Loadout Content:[/b] Drop deadly munitions over their heads with the new Iron Rain Scorestreak, a high-altitude, player-controlled aircraft providing a bird’s-eye view of the battle. Upgrade it further with the Active Camo or Tactical Radar Overclocks.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Black Ops 7 Ranked Play:[/b] Get wins and climb the Ranks in the next season of Multiplayer Ranked Play, featuring a completely overhauled transparent Skill Rating system where every point of SR earned and lost is clearly explained in the post-match summary.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p] [/p][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][p][b] [/b] [/p][p]Liminal (Launch)[/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6/2v2, Small-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e41adb763502e9e78dfb7299debb93b6ff9c5dda.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Descend into a live Guild procedure mid-test, where the patient’s response to the experiment actively rewrites the center of the map. When the subject is calm, a red pillar stands intact on a raised platform; when agitation spikes, it fractures and slams into a crater, throwing up fresh cover and new angles around the impact zone.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/71d96c17491b305bf01c5c187bc695a53582f65f.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]When the subject accepts the procedure, the space shifts into a “nature” state, with organic growth reclaiming the central structure and subtly reshaping lanes and sightlines. Corridors feed the core from both sides, cutting past elevators on one flank and offices on the other, keeping rotations tight and fights constant as the room changes under pressure.[/p][p] [/p][p]Primetime (Launch)[/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0c9098082f493b559e2c1d8b78e40145a527b15a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Let no obstacle stand in your way on Primetime, a new 6v6 Multiplayer map themed around a Japanese game show obstacle course. Battle over speed tracks, Wall Jump across bound pads, and rack up points on the board as Operators weave between supersized crates.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1c2e31f1d5eb5e7db7f00cf9b9b7e1ab8328ba4f.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]Make a splash across the Pool track running over the water, a catapult on either end providing quick access to the middle. To get out of the limelight, head to the close-quarters Backstage or head further out along the southern Cargo path running parallel to the course.[/p][p] [/p][p]Vertigo (Launch)[/p][p][i]Remaster, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e206044cb10042875fd611613237fffdf87bb8f8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]First introduced in [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 2[/i], Vertigo returns fully remastered and ready for action in [i]Black Ops 7[/i]. The map features a new Japanese setting, though the layout will be familiar to veterans of the original.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/745fab79d4f7c4a0bed609fef82180f7b9090ef8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Watch your balance as the wind whips by atop the massive skyscraper, newly refurbished as Guild property. A steep drop-off awaits careless Operators fighting along the outer perimeter amongst the Vents, Utility and Storage sheds, and alongside the Helipad. For sturdier ground, head to the inner walkway connected to the East and West Wing, which funnel players into a tight space with guardrails to keep you from plummeting to your demise. [/p][p] [/p][p]Zenith (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6/2v2, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1ea3a92bed9280ae53acbe127d72cf1424f7f18a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Breach a luxurious cliffside abode in Zenith, a waterfall in the distance and pristine lighting guiding you through the immaculate grounds. Battle inside the building, marveling at the bleeding edge tech and expensive artwork, and check for details on the site intrusion in the Security room.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4e782674c98bc0fab312df57614bedb98cac55e7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For a sneakier approach, traverse the running water below, accessible from the outside and from a secret entrance via the inner Office. Take a good look at the bookshelf to discover the trigger mechanism.[/p][p] [/p][p]Launch (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Remastered, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/341dab6346fd74b04271dcb83664a3371fe9233b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Launch map first introduced in the original [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops[/i] returns![/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/93d26d51350d79805bd076f68260c59af527539f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Deploy to this mid-sized map and fight the enemy team across the industrial facility, including the Fuel Yard, Loading, and the Launch Pad itself. Climb the stairwells to battle around the blast shield or fight below the rocket’s thrusters… just not when it’s taking off.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h3]Multiplayer Modes[/h3][p] [/p][p]Black Ops Classic (Launch)[/p][p][i]New Mode (Moshpit)[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Wind back the clock in Black Ops Classic, a new throwback mode inspired by classic [i]Black Ops[/i] gameplay. With simplified movement and streamlined Loadouts, this mode focuses on tactical positioning and classic multiplayer fundamentals built on the modern foundation of [i]Black Ops 7[/i]. Jump into iconic throwback maps and core modes including Team Deathmatch, Domination, Hardpoint and Kill Confirmed.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Restrictions: [/b]No Overclock Abilities. No Perk Combat Specialty bonus.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Limited Selection: [/b]Scorestreaks, Perks, Lethal, Tactical, Wildcards, Melee Weapon, Field Upgrades.[/p][p] [/p][p]Blueprint Gun Game (Launch)[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Every plan needs a good outline. Blueprint Gun Game returns for its [i]Black Ops 7 [/i]debut, challenging players to advance through a lineup of Weapon Blueprints. There are no Scorestreaks or Loadouts involved here, just plain old gun skill. Eliminate players with your weapons to advance to the next weapon.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0d9c0c732e7c098341c8e9321e1d3097728d11f6.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]The first player to earn an elimination with every weapon wins. Eliminate enemies with a melee attack to set them back one weapon in the rotation, and use the intel provided by the persistent UAV to track down your next target.[/p][p] [/p][p]6v6 Gunfight (In-Season)[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Get ready to up the ante as Gunfight returns with a 6v6 spin. Players begin each round with the same pre-determined Loadout that changes every two rounds. Health regeneration and respawns are disabled, so make your shots count. If neither team is wiped out in the specified time, the Overtime Flag will spawn; capture it to secure the round win.[/p][p] [/p][p]Team Blueprint Sharpshooter (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Grab your squad and drop into Team Blueprint Sharpshooter, the 6v6 Multiplayer mode where Weapon Blueprints rotate every few seconds. Each weapon cycle swaps to the same new weapon for every Operator, testing your ability to adapt fast, fight hard, and push for victory.[/p][p] [/p][p]Knife Fight (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]This time it’s personal. Ditch the ranged weapons in this melee-only take on the fan-favorite Gunfight mode that forces Operators into intense, close-quarters fights.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Additional Loadout Content[/h3][p] [/p][p]Make your move from above. Call in the new Iron Rain Scorestreak to rise high above the field of battle, raining deadly munitions on the enemy team.[/p][p] [/p][p]New Scorestreak[/p][p][b]Scorestreak: Iron Rain (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]Weekly Challenge Reward[/i][/p][p][b]Score: [/b]825[/p][p][b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/998da5f5a970e7355a5375f125af3aa53174fa2a.jpg"][/img] [/p][p][i]A high-altitude, player-controlled aircraft that provides a bird’s-eye view of the battlefield, allowing tracking and eliminating enemies from above.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Enjoy a birds-eye view of the action below while using this new medium cost Scorestreak designed to pummel enemy forces from above. When called in by the enemy, reach for your Launcher or run for cover.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Overclock Abilities[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Active Camo: [/b]Keeps aircraft hidden. Attacking or taking damage temporarily breaks camouflage.[/p][p][b]Tactical Radar: [/b]Reveals and pings nearby enemies to allies. Grants bonus score when marked enemies are eliminated.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h3]Season 04 Multiplayer Ranked Play[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bdd019930b729c42a1fe67d1e665ac766fa8dcca.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Season 04 Ranked Play Overview[/p][p] [/p][p]Multiplayer Ranked Play gives players the ultimate competitive [i]Call of Duty [/i]experience by offering the same settings, maps, modes, and weapon restrictions used by the Call of Duty® League™.[/p][p] [/p][p]Earn career rewards throughout the lifespan of [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Ranked Play, including Rank Skins and Win Challenge rewards.[/p][p] [/p][p]Ranking System Update[/p][p][/p][p][i]Black Ops 7[/i] Ranked Play is getting clearer in Season 04. The SR (Skill Rating) System has been completely overhauled to remove hidden MMR and instead provide full transparency over every single point of earned or lost SR. In Season 04, your SR gains and losses are driven entirely by your visible Rank and your performance relative to the Rank and performance of other players in the match. Outperform players in your Rank or above you and you’ll continue to climb, but struggle to beat players at your Rank or below you and big SR gains will be harder to come by.[/p][p] [/p][p]SR gains and losses are broken down in detail in the updated Ranked Play Post-Match Summary after each match, so you know exactly what moved the needle. Here are the major changes coming with this SR System overhaul in Season 04:[/p][p] [/p][p][b]SR Gains after Wins[/b][/p][p]The following can be awarded after a Ranked Play win:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p][b]Base Win: [/b]Earn a flat +20 SR for every win, regardless of your current Rank.  [b]Scoreboard Bonus: [/b]Finish among the top 4 players of the match to earn an SR bonus. The higher your Scoreboard position, the bigger the bonus.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Opponent Rank Adjustment: [/b]Receive an SR Adjustment based on the relative Rank of Opponents beaten compared with your current Rank:[/p][list][*][p]Outperform opponents that are higher Rank than you and you’ll receive additional SR bonuses for beating better players.[/p][/*][*][p]However, get beaten by lower Ranked opponents and your SR total for the match will be reduced because you were outperformed by weaker opponents.[/p][/*][*][p]Additionally, outperforming lower Ranked opponents will reduce your SR total for the match because you were expected to perform better than the weaker opponents you beat.[/p][/*][*][p]To maximize your Opponent Rank adjustment and receive big SR gains: prove you belong to a higher Rank by outperforming opponents that are currently in your Rank or are higher Rank than you.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Underdog Team Bonus: [/b]Awarded if you beat a significantly higher-Ranked team, while a [b]Favored Team Penalty[/b] is subtracted if the team you beat was lower Ranked.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]SR Deductions after Losses:[/b][/p][p]The following SR deductions and adjustments occur after a Ranked Play loss:[/p][p][b]Base Loss: [/b]-20 SR is deducted when losing a match in Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, or Diamond Ranks. This Base Loss amount increases for Crimson Rank and above so that players are required to consistently exceed expectations of their current Rank to continue to climb into the highest Ranks and the Top 250:[/p][list][*][p][b]Crimson Rank:[/b] -30 SR per Loss[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]10,000 SR+:[/b] -40 SR per Loss[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]12,500 SR+: [/b]-50 SR per Loss[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]15,000 SR+: -[/b]55 SR per Loss[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]17,500 SR+:[/b] -60 SR per Loss[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]20,000 SR+:[/b] -65 SR per Loss[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Underdog Team Bonus: [/b]Your SR loss for the match is reduced if you lost to a significantly higher-Ranked team. Lose to a lower Ranked team and you’ll receive a bigger SR loss via the [b]Favored Team Penalty[/b].[/p][p] [/p][p]Party Size Restriction Update[/p][p] [/p][p]Back in Season 02, [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Ranked Play introduced Party Size Restrictions that limited players in Crimson and above to two-player parties. This was done to ensure that parties did not give players in the highest Ranks a competitive advantage. However, we’ve seen consistent feedback from players who feel like the current party rules are too restrictive and have impacted their ability to party up with friends in Ranked.[/p][p] [/p][p]Season 04 changes the Ranked Play Party Size Restrictions. Crimson players will now be free to form up to four-player parties without size restrictions. Iridescent and Top 250 players will continue to be restricted to two-player parties to ensure that parties do not give players competing for the top Rank a competitive advantage.[/p][p] [/p][p]Season 04 Ranked Play Rewards[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/be359af1040745b3f9ccd485a50cfc69b5d03ac2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b] [/b]Each season comes with its own seasonal rewards that that can only be earned throughout the duration of that season, including the following Weapon Blueprint, Large Decal, Calling Cards, and Weapon Camos:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p][b]Get 10 Wins:[/b] Pro Issue Far from their idyllic presentation in other forms of Nuketown, this neighborhood is tainted with corruption, and the denizens and their Rad-Hounds are anything but friendly.[/p][p][/p][p]Scour the map for upgrades: Perks, Pack-a-Punch, Mystery Box, the Arsenal, Wall Buys, and anything else you can get your hands on to climb the rounds in a confined location, extending from the cul-de-sac out to Trinity Ave. You might not get out alive, but you can at least take down as many undead as you can with you.[/p][p] [/p][p]Survive as long as you can to earn the following rewards:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]“Population: Just You” Animated Emblem and 1,000 XP (complete Round 10).[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Dead End” Weapon Charm and 2,500 XP (complete Round 25)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Time Out” GobbleGum and 5,000 XP (complete Round 50)[/p][/*][/list][h3] [/h3][h3]Directed Mode: Totenreich (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/223890cb38e435f8d90158dee6bcfb7e6a7684e9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Get extra guidance for the Main Quest on Totenreich as Season 04 brings Directed Mode to the map, delivering on-screen quest steps and a max round cap of 15.[/p][p] [/p][p]Explore the ancient fishing village’s dark past under the shadow of giants while battling new enemies including the undead Viking warrior spirit known as the Necropincer, a trident wielding adversary with a giant crab claw in place of its left arm. Stay tuned for the Season 04 Reloaded blog arriving just prior to the Mid-Season for more.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h2][u]Call of Duty®: Warzone™ Content[/u][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ded8d295d0f30beb111c545cc63b53b0b76a6f67.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]CALL OF DUTY: WARZONE SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Fortune’s Keep Refresh:[/b] The Resurgence map pool expands in Season 04 as the Fortune’s Keep Refresh arrives. Whether you’re returning to the location or visiting for the first time, this iteration supports the advanced movement mechanics and other features of [i]Black Ops 7[/i] along with a handful of updated micro POIs and other changes.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Modes:[/b] Fight for your slice of Verdansk in the 52v52 Clash mode arriving at launch. In the Mid-Season, be the first squad to cycle through every weapon in Squad Gun Game.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]A New Season in Rebirth Island: [/b]The snow has melted and a new season arrives in Rebirth Island. Hang up your snow gear, enjoy the fresh breeze, and push toward that next victory.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Gameplay Features:[/b] Gain access to a mobile Black Market with the new Shadowlink Contract exclusively available in Fortune’s Keep Refresh. Get safely back on your feet into cover with the Advanced Self Revive, and later in the season, see if you have what it takes to acquire and complete the difficult Champion’s Quest.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Resurgence Ranked Play: [/b]Rank up and earn rewards in a new season of Ranked Play: Resurgence including unique Weapon Camos you won’t want to miss.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][b] [/b][/p][p] [/p][h3]Fortune’s Keep Refresh (Launch)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/40332ccc27a7a620a39812f8b07aea4f9a3022dd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]It’s the Fortune’s Keep you know and love, now playable like never before. Revisit your favorite haunts and explore new points of interests with enhanced movement and fresh features that bring a new depth to gameplay. For new and returning players, here’s a review of the major points of interest on the map, followed by a closer look at three updated micro POIs found throughout the island.[/p][p] [/p][h3]The Major POIs[/h3][p] [/p][p]Terraces[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/532f414b9d26c98981aa0718f3ba68e643b51d9f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Surrounded by high walls and buildings, the Terraces are a well-fortified POI with access points out to the northern shore and toward the adjacent Keep. Stay on the move and avoid the central fountain, a focal point for all the surrounding vantage points around it. Use the stairs and vine trellises located all over the area to gain some elevation.[/p][p] [/p][p]Keep[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/15edbe05b7eecd878ff0c3171f855476f6b09c85.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Prepare for a variety of engagement types across the Keep; although the structure is large, its sheer number of corridors and rooms turn a long-distance fight into a short one in seconds. The POI extends to the Keep’s outer walls, so check every corner while approaching the sprawling compound, and use all available intel to track enemy movement within.[/p][p] [/p][p]Gatehouse[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3f209d5c8770564a095ec02b6b388513155a9f9e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Gatehouse is the entrance to the Keep’s primary grounds and sits directly in the center of the island. Surrounded by several other major POIs, it’s a difficult area to control, though the reward is worth the risk if you’re ready for constant engagements around it. Note the nearby sewer entrance for a concealed flanking path, and the Ascender giving access to the top of the Gatehouse battlements.[/p][p] [/p][p]Bay[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/06ed951dcec95910cb62bdc5a76c71dcfea2a198.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Positioned along the eastern shore, the once peaceful Bay is home to beachfronts, cliffsides, and the new Sea Science Aquatic Laboratory. Use the Bay’s lowered elevation to keep out sight from the main roads, and as a reliable access point for watercraft with helipad right next to the boat launch. Don’t miss the cliff tunnels up the dirt path, providing a stealthy approach toward the Keep.[/p][p] [/p][p]Winery[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a6b086196f1126fbb482d81ca551ea8c1f9db0bb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Taking up a significant portion of the island’s east end, the Winery is often contested, whether fighting within the center courtyard or sending out suppressive fire around its perimeter. Note that there are several points of access down into the basement below, a haven from the action above, though be prepared for close-quarters combat should an enemy follow you there.[/p][p] [/p][p]Pier[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4d42973c10909b75c24ac4a11d031fbc346e28db.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Like the Bay POI, the Pier offers a respite from the main action of the island, but that hardly makes it a light walk along the beach. Expect to encounter vehicles traversing the Pier as it is also near a major crossroad. Use the dotted beach terrain and scenery, as well as the cliffside, to escape from tough fights and get into a better position for the counterattack.[/p][p] [/p][p]Lighthouse[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ba302c5def3483f85527864847384ffe544dab4f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Check for snipers when approaching the Lighthouse, an Ascender giving access to its upper platform with views over a significant portion of the surrounding area. The shoreline here is extremely dangerous, with little cover against attacks from above. Instead, consider exploring behind the Lighthouse when traversing the nearby grounds, full of cover points with a tunnel into the cliffside and zipline toward Smuggler’s Cove.[/p][p] [/p][p]Overlook[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bb8248af12e1f8600098e0812c6980bf00a5284a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Overlook provides a powerful vantage point over the Town and its surrounding areas. The section closest to Smuggler’s Cove features a high-end restaurant with a picturesque view of both the ocean and the eastern end of Fortune’s Keep, while farther up you’ll find a small village area including access to the tallest section of the cliff. Claiming this area offers great map control in the vicinity, so long as the gas hasn’t cleared the place out yet.[/p][p] [/p][p]Town[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d7dfecc39f899bb1918d2db014126951a461b557.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Operators seeking close-quarters, urban combat should head into Town along the map’s western shore. A treasure trove a loot awaits within its tightly packed layout, so long as you’re prepared to engage enemies at a moment’s notice and often face to face. Its lower elevation makes the area susceptible to attacks from the outside, so be on the lookout for enemy forces when it’s time to exit the area.[/p][p] [/p][p]Graveyard[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4334c93ee1f02c780b11667ef4a1510b981c1562.jpg"][/img][/p][p]There’s little cover here, but the tombs and outer walls do provide some cover in a pinch. There’s a steep drop off to the shore here, so beware of enemy squads attempting a flanking attack from the west. Within the Graveyard, look for the easternmost sepulcher providing access to a belowground passageway. If you prefer a clear view, climb the stairs to the top of the nearby round tower.[/p][p] [/p][p]Grotto[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/92e38e32438a9d449c29ba73c5561b02349b20cb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Get way below the action in the Grotto, positioned at the base of the cliffs with access to several cave systems leading to other parts of the map like the Lighthouse and the Graveyard. Getting to these cave systems requires landing safely and fighting any enemy squads within the Grotto or directly above on the surface.[/p][p] [/p][p]Smuggler’s Cove[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/db890d8a6b3c1a6fb46c27fc432c2bbb402fcd28.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Secluded from the main island, Smuggler’s Cove upholds its reputation for stockpiling illegally sourced cargo within the deep-sea caves. The shallow waters somewhat limit mobility, so seek out an elevated position when possible. For a quick escape, back up into the cave systems of the nearby Grotto or use the area’s system of ladders, walkways, and Ascenders to reclaim the high ground.[/p][p] [/p][p]Research Vessel[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d38397073857dfac0db935621ac8621dba4bff4f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This pontoon-style watercraft circles the shoreline of Fortune’s Keep in the opening minutes of the match before eventually dropping anchor. The multi-level POI is equipped with a Buy Station, Ammo Cache, UAV Tower, and a limited use POI wide gas decontamination system. It’s the only POI on Fortune’s Keep that maintains a UAV Tower which makes it an incredibly desirable location for tracking enemy movement. When inland, watch for snipers firing from the deck.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Micro POI Updates[/h3][p] [/p][p]Sea Science Aquatic Laboratory[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b9751ae3ad4654c5fc4f9e8bb0557f716c9a6171.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Head to the Bay POI to visit Sea Science Aquatic Laboratory located right on the boat launch. The two-story building features the latest in marine research, though in the midst of battle, keep your eyes peeled for enemies making their way into the main structure. With a staircase on either side and an assortment of tightly packed rooms, combat can erupt at any moment.[/p][p][/p][p]For a simpler cover point, move into one of the smaller research center outbuildings, one positioned on the water by the boat launch ramp and the other above the main building for a more elevated vantage point. [/p][p] [/p][p]Capt. Bubby’s Chum Haus[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c66e8e7df5d69f77d57077bdd68c073e44e11a75.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Between the Pier and Lighthouse now stands the fast-food restaurant, Capt. Bubby’s Chum Haus. Stop in for some grub straight from the shoreline, from Bubby’s Up-Chunk Chowder to Smothered Seagull Cutlet. The one-story building marks a strong cover point in the area. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/887b4b0f6c08ba5f52fff33e6e61842018a5c834.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Fire out the windows on enemy targets in the surrounding lot or get behind the service counter for defending against enemies attempting to breach the building.[/p][p] [/p][p]Smuggler HQ[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e1b4eda4c41b00a821e066a9cc87562ea077157a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Positioned right near the opening of the Grotto near the Gatehouse, the Smuggler HQ offers a valuable looting and cover point positioned right in the center of the map. Use the cluster of buildings and shipping containers to get out of sight from the main roads, resupply, and ambush unsuspecting passersby. The centrally located POI offers a great pivot point toward other areas of the map, whether your squad’s planning an attack toward the northern Keep or elsewhere on the island.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h3]New Modes and Weekend LTMS (Launch, Mid-Season)[/h3][p] [/p][p]Clash (Launch)[/p][p][i]52v52, Verdansk, Returning[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/61c2144149030a721793d41d07da1739baa04757.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]Prepare for a largescale team skirmish in the 52v52 Clash Mode, with the battle location taking place in one of nine POIs within Verdansk, including the returning POIs Farm, Promenade East, Quarry, and Boneyard plus five new Clash zones in Airport, Signal Station, Launch Pad, Port, and Factory.[/p][p] [/p][p]The first team to reach the point limit — or whoever has the highest point total when the match timer runs out — wins the game, with points being allocated as such:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]Earn 1 point per elimination.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Earn 10 points per completed Contract.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Earn 20 points per each bonus crate capture.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Earn 40 points per each Domination point capture.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Get the advantage any way you can, from seeking out vehicles including the new LTV mid-sized truck equipped with a turret, completing Contracts for points and in-match rewards, and building up your cash reserves for Buy Station purchases like the Death Machine, D.A.W.G., and, when it’s time to bring in the big guns, the VTOL Warship. Work with your squad and the greater team to push the fight, capture Domination points, and grind the enemy forces into the dirt.[/p][p] [/p][p]Squad Gun Game (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Resurgence Maps[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Experience Gun Game in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] for the first time ever as squads drop into Resurgence maps with the objective of being the first to cycle through a pre-determined number of weapons. Vault Edition: [i]Call of Duty[/i] Loyalty Discount[/p][p][i]Via digital Pre-order and Pre-purchase on platform storefronts[/i][/p][p][/p][p]If you’ve digitally or physically owned and played a premium [i]Call of Duty[/i] title dating back to [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare[/i] (2019), or have played one of these titles via Game Pass and have an active Game Pass Ultimate, Premium, or PC subscription, expect to digitally [b]preorder the Vault Edition of [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] with a 10% discount[/b] compared to the  standard MSRP.[/p][p]Here’s how this works:[/p][h2]Qualifying Call of Duty Titles[/h2][p]The discount is available if you own and have played a qualifying previous title, through digital or physical purchase, via an active Game Pass Ultimate, Premium, or PC subscription that has previously played one of these titles, or by claiming the title via PlayStation® Plus Monthly Games. Any edition of the previous title qualifies. Here are the titles:[/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare[/i] (2019)[/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered (2020)[/i][/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War[/i][/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Vanguard[/i][/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II[/i] (2022)[/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III[/i] (2023)[/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6[/i][/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 7[/i][/p][h3]Qualifying Platform Eligibility[/h3][p]The discount is only available at checkout if you pre-order or pre-purchase [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] on the same gaming platform and with the same platform account used for the previous qualifying title.[/p][h3]Loyalty Discount: Additional Information[/h3][p]Ensure you claim your Loyalty Discount in time, and note the following intel:[/p][p]·      Expect a 10% discount to the Vault Edition of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i].[/p][p]·      This discount applies to the [b]Vault Edition of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] only[/b].[/p][p]·      The discount should appear [b]within the in-game store or platform digital storefront[/b], prior to checkout.[/p][p]·      This discount [b]only applies to pre-orders and pre-purchases[/b]; this offer is valid until October 23, 2026. This offer is subject to change.[/p][p]·      This discount is [b]not available to Vault upgrades[/b]; meaning you cannot pre-order or pre-purchase the Standard Digital Edition and then upgrade to the Vault Edition afterwards and obtain the discount.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Further Information: [/b]If you require additional support information or guidance regarding the Loyalty Discount, please visit [url="http://support.activision.com/mw4"]Activision Support’s [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] page[/url].
[/p][p]Pre-Purchase now![/p]

newsitems.title: Modern Warfare 4 Editions: Pre-order Benefits Detailed
newsitems.author: RedBruto
newsitems.contents: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/46f4a9dd22524376ef871230f18d6eddcdc9959a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="jLbst85USN8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4: Pre-order Benefits[/h2][p][b]Warfare Without Limits: [/b][i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare®[/i] 4 launches on October 23, 2026. Lock in your preferred edition now to secure a full slate of rewards and bonus content available with digital pre-purchases on PC. See the full breakdown of included benefits in the chart below:[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/6ea1ef82196468198d9b2c5f8c15b9b945a41c14.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p]Pre-purchases are rolling live for Steam as of today, May 28. Note that it may take some time for pre-order pages to fully cascade across these platforms and by region. Continue to check-in throughout the day if you don't immediately see pages live for your platform of choice.[/p][p] [/p][h3]What are the Available Editions?[/h3][p]There are two editions of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] to consider for pre-order or pre-purchase:[/p][p]·      [b]Digital:[/b] Vault Edition (all platforms).[/p][p]·      [b]Digital:[/b] Standard Edition (all platforms).[/p][h2] [/h2][h2]Modern Warfare 4: Vault Edition[/h2][p][b] [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/46f4a9dd22524376ef871230f18d6eddcdc9959a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]With an incredible selection of premium content, the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Vault Edition offers exceptional value — especially when combined with the 10% Loyalty Discount† — alongside exclusive rewards available only through this edition. Secure the Vault Edition to gain access to all included content, rewards, and edition-specific benefits:[/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] Digital Edition[/p][p]·      Early access to the Open Beta*[/p][p]·      Hunter Killer Operator Skin**[/p][p]·      Hostile Alliance Operator Pack[/p][p]·      Special Forces Operator Pack[/p][p]·      Signature Weapon Collection[/p][p]·      BlackCell (One Season)***[/p][p]·      DMZ Deployment Bonus[/p][p] [/p][p]Want the full details about the Vault Edition Loyalty Discount? Keep reading.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h2]What are the Pre-order and Vault Edition Benefits?[/h2][p] [/p][p]Let’s take a closer look at the rewards and bonus content included with your pre-order or pre-purchase, as well as Vault Edition content:[/p][p] [/p][h3]Early Access to the Open Beta*[/h3][p][b][i]Pre-order or Pre-purchase:[/i][/b][i] Digital Standard or Vault  Standard Edition[/i][/p][p][b]Availability:[/b] At the start of the [i]Modern Warfare 4 [/i]Open Beta, later this year.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/3b36b86b54da444e47687eefaa03e46e6d605de5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Pre-order any of the two editions of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] to secure early access to the [b]Open Beta[/b]. Exact Beta timing and availability details will be announced soon.[/p][p][b]Beta Codes: [/b]Players who digitally pre-order [i]Modern Warfare 4 [/i]are automatically granted Early Access to the Open Beta and do not require a Beta Code.[/p][p]Players who do not pre-order [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] should still expect to access the open portion of the Beta.[/p][p][i]* Actual launch date(s), times, and platform availability of MP Beta subject to change. See [/i][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.callofduty.com/beta"]www.callofduty.com/beta[/url][/p][p][/p][p][i] for more details. Minimum Open Beta duration is 2 days. Limited time only. Internet connection required. Online multiplayer subscription may be required for MP Beta.[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]Hunter Killer Operator Skin**[/h3][p][b][i]Pre-order or Pre-purchase:[/i][/b][i] Digital Standard or Vault Edition[/i][/p][p]·      [b]Availability:[/b] Instantly in [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty[/i]: [i]Warzone[/i]™, and at launch in [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], upon pre-order or pre-purchase.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/9c3c764b4d156b4d58a6095532325018d4188476.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Pre-order or pre-purchase either of the Digital Editions of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], and immediately receive [b]Hunter Killer[/b], a clandestine field operative with a talent for ending engagements.[/p][p]·      Hunter Killer (and the Hunter Killer Skin) instantly becomes available in the Operators Menu of Call of Duty: [i]Black Ops 7[/i] or [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] next time you access the game.[/p][p] [/p][p]The Hunter Killer Operator Skin will also be available in [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] at launch on October 23. [i](**Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 or Call of Duty: Warzone on your chosen platform is required to redeem. Sold / downloaded separately. Must be redeemed by October 23, 2027.)[/i][/p][p] [/p][h3]Hostile Alliance Operator Pack[/h3][p][b][i]Pre-order, Pre-purchase, or Purchase: [/i][/b][i]Vault Edition[/i][/p][p]·      [b]Availability:[/b] At game launch on October 23.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/381cdc27c05d5a93e83376c2a1b742a07de5ab03.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Unlock the [b]Hostile Alliance Operator Pack[/b], enabling access to the following Operators at launch: Price, Valeria, Ghost, and Blix. Note that Price and Valeria have masked and unmasked variant skins.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Special Forces Operator Pack[/h3][p][b][i]Pre-order, Pre-purchase, or Purchase: [/i][/b][i]Vault Edition[/i][/p][p]·      [b]Availability:[/b] At game launch on October 23.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/270cac7988aa7cc0181b9d656165f9ed36bc2965.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]An additional Operator Pack is available for those with the [i]Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition[/i]: Unlock the [b]Special Forces Operator Pack[/b], including four Operators, each with a skin representing their country of origin, each with a voice pack in their local language:[/p][p]·      COM SFT (France)[/p][p]·      KSK Amphibious (Germany)[/p][p]·      South Korean Special Forces (South Korea)[/p][p]·      SAS (United Kingdom)[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]Signature Weapon Collection[/h3][p][b][i]Pre-order, Pre-purchase, or Purchase: [/i][/b][i]Vault Edition[/i][/p][p]·      [b]Availability:[/b] At game launch on October 23.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/6051653ca2e35214e018fe3058acbd46f159911f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Own the [i]Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition[/i] to immediately unlock five different weapons that form the [b]Signature Weapon Collection[/b]. The ranged weapons come with multiple Attachments including an Apex Attachment, all of which are accessible at game launch. Here are the available weapons and Blueprints:[/p][p]·      [b]Kastov 762 Assault Rifle[/b] and [b]“Voltspine”[/b] Blueprint[/p][p]·      [b]ISO Nightshade Submachine Gun[/b] and [b]“La Sombra Venenosa”[/b] (“The Poisonous Shadow”) Blueprint[/p][p]·      [b]Rezi 12 Shotgun[/b] and [b]“Shattered Code”[/b] Blueprint[/p][p]·      [b]Oris 8.6 Marksman Rifle[/b] and [b]“Volt-Edge”[/b] Blueprint[/p][p]·      [b]Combat Knife (Melee) [/b]and [b]“Sombra Besada” [/b](“Shadow’s Kiss”) Blueprint[/p][p] [/p][p]Kastov 762 and “Voltspine” Blueprint[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/cc2b37eccbc62f59b4d8a4025f77a0ca53c76793.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A full-auto 7.62x39mm rifle offering heavy per-shot impact with equally firm recoil. Reliable and forceful but requires control to keep on target.[/p][p][b]Kastov Arc (Apex Attachment):[/b] An experimental disruption barrel that emits a concentrated high-intensity RF pulse capable of incapacitating infantry, crippling electronics, and destabilizing vehicles caught in its crosshairs.[/p][p] [/p][p]Iso Nightshade and “La Sombra Venenosa” Blueprint[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/212e11ebef3e910063648b72dc6b8199175741e2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A full-auto 9x19mm SMG with a fast rate of fire, the ISO Nightshade balances controllability, mobility, and close-quarters stopping power into a versatile platform suited for any operator.[/p][p][b]ISO Trace (Apex Attachment):[/b] When hitting a target, Special RFID ammunition transmits a signal back to a built-in optic display on the gun, letting you to track down the victim and finish the job.[/p][p] [/p][p]Rezi 12 and “Shattered Code” Blueprint[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/e0c616f7026fc710550ccdf10ff22cfdfd55d53b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A fast-cycling semi-auto 12-gauge, the Rezi 12 delivers powerful, controlled shots with smooth recovery. Built tough and tuned for decisive close-range work.[/p][p][b]Rezi Enforcer (Apex Attachment):[/b] Enables pump-action cycling and is outfitted with a side-saddle for hot-loaded explosive slugs. The added capability extends the platform’s engagement envelope well beyond traditional 12-gauge roles.[/p][p] [/p][p]Oris 8.6 and “Volt-Edge” Blueprint[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/9da9e5bdb7a24024f69a73ad0a91ac2d3978f16b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A lightweight bolt-action rifle chambered in 8.6 Blackout, the Oris 8.6 delivers impressive energy from a compact, modular frame. Sleek monolithic design and smooth cycling make it effective for precision fire in tight or mobile engagements.[/p][p][b]Oris Razor (Apex Attachment):[/b] A compact blade module mounted to the receiver, housing up to three quick access throwing knives for close-range, low-signature engagements. Designed as a reliable fallback when stealth or conservation of fire matters most.[/p][p] [/p][p]Combat Knife and “Sombra Besada” Blueprint[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/1cf6a2a43a963f42c73cd312270ba146edec398c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Lightweight combat blade with a reinforced spine and vented profile for fast, lethal use in close quarters.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]BlackCell: One Season of Content***[/h3][p][b][i]Pre-order, Pre-purchase, or Purchase: [/i][/b][i]Vault Edition[/i][/p][p]·      [b]Availability: [/b]Access begins with Season 1 (date to be announced).[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/29cdde509b5866addf31d466bbf216876cfa4f18.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Own the [i]Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition[/i] to unlock [b]a single season of BlackCell access. [/b]Timing determines which season of BlackCell of you receive, with the first opportunity being in Season 1:[/p][p]·      Pre-order, pre-purchase, or purchase the [i]Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition and play [/i]before or during Season 1 to unlock Season 1 BlackCell.[/p][p]·      Purchase the [i]Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition [/i]and play after Season 1 to unlock the current BlackCell season.[/p][p]BlackCell includes:[/p][p]·      20 Battle Pass Tier Skips and 1,100 COD Points, instantly unlocked[/p][p]·      Instant access to exclusive content, including a new Operator and Weapon Blueprint.[/p][p]·      BlackCell variants of select Battle Pass content including Operators, Weapon Blueprints, and more.[/p][p]·      Full Battle Pass with 100+ rewards, including weapons, Operator Skins, Blueprints, and COD Points.[/p][p][i](*** BlackCell, Battle Pass, Call of Duty Points and Tier Skips will be accessible in Modern Warfare 4 upon availability of the Season 1 Battle Pass in-game. Redemption applies to one Season of the Modern Warfare 4 Battle Pass only.)[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][h3]DMZ Deployment Bonus[/h3][p][b][i]Pre-order, Pre-purchase, or Purchase: [/i][/b][i]Vault Edition[/i][/p][p]·      [b]Availability:[/b] At game launch on October 23.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/4e4f89217278f38796cbb0cae4be571e1c820528.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Vault Edition owners can expect additional DMZ content via a Deployment Bonus at launch. Stay tuned for more details on the exact contents of the Deployment Bonus.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h2]Vault Edition: [i]Call of Duty[/i] Loyalty Discount†[/h2][p][i]Via digital Pre-order and Pre-purchase on platform storefronts[/i][/p][p]If you’ve digitally or physically owned and played a premium [i]Call of Duty[/i] title dating back to [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare[/i] (2019), or have played one of these titles via Game Pass and have an active Game Pass Ultimate, Premium, or PC subscription, expect to digitally [b]preorder the Vault Edition of [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] with a 10% discount[/b] compared to the  standard MSRP.[/p][p]Here’s how this works:[/p][h2]Qualifying Call of Duty Titles[/h2][p]The discount is available if you own and have played a qualifying previous title, through digital or physical purchase, via an active Game Pass Ultimate, Premium, or PC subscription that has previously played one of these titles, or by claiming the title via PlayStation® Plus Monthly Games. Any edition of the previous title qualifies. Here are the titles:[/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare[/i] (2019)[/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered (2020)[/i][/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War[/i][/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Vanguard[/i][/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II[/i] (2022)[/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III[/i] (2023)[/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6[/i][/p][p]·      [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 7[/i][/p][h3]Qualifying Platform Eligibility[/h3][p]The discount is only available at checkout if you pre-order or pre-purchase [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] on the same gaming platform and with the same platform account used for the previous qualifying title.[/p][h3]Loyalty Discount: Additional Information[/h3][p]Ensure you claim your Loyalty Discount in time, and note the following intel:[/p][p]·      Expect a 10% discount to the Vault Edition of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i].[/p][p]·      This discount applies to the [b]Vault Edition of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] only[/b].[/p][p]·      The discount should appear [b]within the in-game store or platform digital storefront[/b], prior to checkout.[/p][p]·      This discount [b]only applies to pre-orders and pre-purchases[/b]; this offer is valid until October 23, 2026. This offer is subject to change.[/p][p]·      This discount is [b]not available to Vault upgrades[/b]; meaning you cannot pre-order or pre-purchase the Standard Digital Edition and then upgrade to the Vault Edition afterwards and obtain the discount.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Further Information: [/b]If you require additional support information or guidance regarding the Loyalty Discount, please visit [url="http://support.activision.com/mw4"]Activision Support’s [/url][i][url="http://support.activision.com/mw4"]Modern Warfare 4[/url][/i][url="http://support.activision.com/mw4"] page[/url].[/p][p] [/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4: Digital Standard Editions[/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/4fc5b3f3ff2c35e65cc0e14c0da381646033138d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In addition to the Vault Edition, you can pre-purchase (on PC) a Digital Standard Edition of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] on the platforms listed at the start of this Blog. The Digital Standard Edition consists of the full game and the following benefits:[/p][p]·      Open Beta Early Access (Pre-order or Pre-purchase benefit)[/p][p]·      Hunter Killer Operator Skin (Pre-order or Pre-purchase Instant benefit in [i]Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty[/i]: [i]Warzone[/i])[/p][h3] [/h3][h3]Vault Edition Upgrade[/h3][p][i]From Digital Edition to Vault Edition[/i][/p][p]If you pre-order the Digital Standard Edition of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], you can upgrade to the Vault Edition at a later date, provided the upgrade is made on the same platform as your original purchase.[/p][p][b]Note: [/b]Upgrade steps may vary by platform. Refer to your platform’s storefront for details.[/p][h3]How Do I Upgrade to the Vault Edition?[/h3][p][b]Steam:[/b] Upgrade via the in-game store or Steam where the Digital Standard Edition was pre-purchased.[/p][p]Additional Notes:[/p][p][b]Price:[/b] The cost to upgrade from a Digital Standard Edition to the Vault Edition is $30 U.S. SRP (or regional equivalent).[/p][p][b]Ineligibility Notes:[/b] The Vault Edition is only available digitally. The Vault Edition Loyalty Discount (see above) is not available if you decide to upgrade.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Stay Frosty: Additional Intel Incoming[/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45718718/73f3eeca662281a3f3d3b18c319c887ca30b36d6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Track the latest official [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] intel on the Call of Duty Blog as we move toward additional information drops, the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Open Beta, and launch on October 23.[/p][p][/p][p]Preorders are available now at participating retailers, in-game, on platform stores, or at [/p][p][url="https://CallofDuty.com"]CallofDuty.com[/url][/p][p].[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h3]Development Credits[/h3][p] [/p][p]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 development is led by Infinity Ward, and will be available globally on PC via Steam on Friday, October 23rd, 2026.[/p][p] [/p][p]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 for the PC delivers a fully optimized experience, led by Infinity Ward in partnership with Beenox, for Steam.[/p][p] [/p][p]Additional development by — in alphabetical order — Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Raven Software, Sledgehammer Games, and Treyarch.[/p][p][i]Online multiplayer subscription may be required (sold separately).[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]On PC, TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot required, other security measures may be enforced. [/i][url="https://support.activision.com/articles/trusted-platform-module-and-secure-boot"]Learn more here[/url].[/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Content, features, services, online play, and support not available in all regions, and may vary, change, or terminate.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Requires an Activision account and acceptance of the Activision Software License and Services Agreement. A mobile phone number linked to your Activision account may be required to play Modern Warfare 4.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Additional storage space may be required for mandatory game updates.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p] [/p][p][i]†Loyalty discount of 10% is based on MSRP.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]©/TM/[/i]©[i] 2026 Activision Publishing, Inc.For more information, please visit [/i][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.callofduty.com"]www.callofduty.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p][i] and [/i][/p][p][/p][p][i], and follow [url="https://twitter.com/activision"]@Activision[/url] and [url="https://twitter.com/CallofDuty"]@CallofDuty[/url] on X, Instagram, and Facebook. For Call of Duty Updates, follow [url="https://twitter.com/CODUpdates"]@CODUpdates[/url] on X.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][i]Join [url="http://discord.gg/CallofdutyOfficial"]Call of Duty's Official Discord[/url] to get the latest updates and maybe even meet your next squadmate![/i][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p]
