newsitems.title: Announcing Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
newsitems.author: RedBruto
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4fc5b3f3ff2c35e65cc0e14c0da381646033138d.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Warfare Without Limits[/h2][p]War erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches a full-scale invasion that threatens to destabilize the world in [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i]. A young squad of South Korean soldiers fights to survive on the collapsing front lines, while half a world away a vengeful Captain Price wages a personal war from the shadows as he stays one step ahead of those hunting him. As Price’s off-book mission collides with the forces behind the invasion, the war spreads beyond anyone’s control.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="jLbst85USN8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] pushes the series into darker and more dangerous territory, bringing long-running storylines to a powerful and emotional breaking point.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ef678fcea54e3b6d9b49d59a796313f58f2b262e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Campaign drops players into trench warfare in Korea, close-quarters combat in New York, high-octane chases through Paris, SAS night raids in Mumbai, and city-wide assaults to reclaim occupied territory. Multiplayer delivers grounded, precise combat where fluid movement, player choice, and greater control define every engagement. In DMZ, players operate as an off-the-books asset behind enemy lines, where every deployment into contested territory forces hard choices about which objectives to pursue, what to secure, and when to get out.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/32041265bb850b70661a6811cc8cd99881434f90.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] will launch on October 23, 2026, and be available on PC.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Campaign // Overview[/h2][p] [/p][h3]No Line Holds Forever[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ce26b26546ed4d754d5b436263bad7ac76a8f359.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Fight as Private Park, a young South Korean soldier facing live combat for the first time alongside his squad. What begins as a routine patrol descends into chaos when North Korea launches a full-scale invasion, forcing Park and his unit into a desperate fight through collapsing cities and counteroffensives. The Campaign drops players into the chaos, pressure, and split-second intensity of ground-level combat.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/391866de2f707cd525719e2a875165fd5a150264.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This is a new setting for the franchise, grounded in the military authenticity [i]Modern Warfare[/i] is known for and built with attention to the culture, history, and military detail of the region. The conflict in Korea becomes the catalyst for a broader war.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4adfa81185a4e2a00f5d1790427ed06409bfe3a3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Beyond the front lines, operator-turned-outlaw Captain Price works outside the system he once served. A hunt for revenge draws Price toward a weapon powerful enough to shift the balance of power, setting in motion a conflict far greater than he ever anticipated. Forced into uneasy alliances and illicit operations, Price is pulled deeper into consequences he can no longer escape.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f602adbc3af72c1f145a11afe104cb81dd6136ee.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f6dce64be6f317de9c54e18f20d8ae30b7c96f10.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cc12622d4a8c65bd99ec24f8385eb346ee07319d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c7ac838ee565ebe6d371da28cc7e43fa407a493f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0ac95026d4e80fed5cad0c224938147cad400c36.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c903df79d70e1ba49df745e77d707c88083026f2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A nightmare scenario unfolds as overzealous leaders, shadow operations, and outside interference push the conflict toward the brink of global catastrophe. From large-scale battles and covert missions to combined-arms warfare and cinematic set pieces, the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Campaign delivers gritty combat and gameplay variety across a war that spreads far beyond the front lines.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Multiplayer // Overview[/h2][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Multiplayer delivers grounded, precise combat built around fluid movement that provides greater control in every fight. Below are some key innovations to the series:[/p][h3]Ballistic Authority[/h3][p]For [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], a new weapon-first technology stack unifies precision aiming, physical handling, realistic audio propagation, enhanced visibility, and smarter combat perception into the most authentic [i]Modern Warfare [/i]gunplay yet. Bullet trajectory, weapon motion, Operator stance, camera, audio, FOV, and target visibility all line up in one highly tuned combat fidelity system. The promise is simple: no bloom, no guesswork, and no doubt. Every shot tells the truth.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bac70e54847c575b42c8d0f5dde96f976fc6b6e0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]·      Bloom has been removed, making hipfire shots feel more direct, predictable, and connected to where the weapon is pointed.[/p][p]·      Recoil, convergence, and weapon handling have been rebuilt to more directly reflect player input.[/p][p]·      Depth of field and visual effects have been refined to improve enemy visibility without sacrificing authenticity.[/p][p]·      Weapons respond more naturally to player movement, stance changes, and the environment, creating more consistent behavior in every engagement.[/p][h3]Movement[/h3][p]Movement in [i]Modern Warfare 4 [/i]is built around fluidity, control, and player freedom, delivering fast, grounded combat that keeps Operators responsive through every engagement while expanding how players move, fight, and adapt across the environment. Refined movement systems are designed to support a wide range of playstyles:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f4bd780d2af496b23faebb1eae17317a52c5c43f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]• Traversal, combat movement, and gunplay transitions are designed to feel seamless and responsive, preserving momentum while maintaining control under pressure.[/p][p]• Expanded movement options for Mantling, Climbing, Hanging and Jumping create new opportunities to reposition, flank, navigate vertical spaces, and approach engagements from multiple angles across increasingly dynamic combat environments.[/p][p]• Every movement system is designed to preserve the grounded realism, physicality, and combat intensity that define [i]Modern Warfare[/i] while delivering the fluid, cinematic intensity of operating as an elite soldier in the field, whether you prefer a methodical, tactical approach or aggressive plays.[/p][h3]Maps[/h3][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] launches with a global set of grounded, visually distinct environments spanning locations around the world, with the 12 Core launch maps — each with a custom infil and distinct visual identity — forming the foundation of a broader Multiplayer offering. In addition, Kill Block, a live-fire training facility built for elite operators, gives players a fresh gameplay experience with every new round. Multiplayer also includes dedicated Gunfight maps and multiple Big War maps built for large-scale vehicles and infantry combat across locations shaped by the Campaign’s global conflict.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/31d4c909b735825e18512bf902df61646a990f30.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Every [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] map is designed to keep combat fast, tactical, and competitive while giving players multiple routes and opportunities to adapt from one engagement to the next.  [/p][h3]Kill Block[/h3][p]Taking place inside the Westbridge Training Facility, Kill Block introduces a dynamic new Multiplayer battleground where the combat space reconfigures between rounds, reshaping sightlines, routes, and cover to keep players adapting in real time. Shaped from a set of purpose-built modular sections capable of creating more than 500 distinct configurations, each match creates its own combat rhythm and tactical challenges. Expect more sections and even more configurations during [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]’s live seasons.[/p][p]Kill Block supports expanded Gunfight formats, including 3v3 and 10v10 experiences, with future support planned for more core Multiplayer modes. Designed for high-intensity play, Kill Block forces players to think quickly, fight for control, and adjust engagement tactics every round.[/p][p][/p][h3]Progression and Customization[/h3][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] expands player customization while making it faster and easier to get into the action. A redesigned Create-a-Class system unifies Operators, weapons, Equipment, and Killstreaks into a single loadout, giving players quicker access to specialized builds tailored to different tactics and playstyles.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0cd59c7a91551190f88b01565f9100fe5faa2281.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Gunsmith returns with deeper customization options while remaining approachable for all players, with attachments now shared by weapon class to streamline build creation and experimentation. New to [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], Gunny brings a Gunnery Sergeant’s eye to weapon customization, helping players quickly assemble effective builds based on their preferred playstyle and unlocked attachments. Featuring configurations developed by Infinity Ward’s Weapons Team, Gunny can instantly configure practical close-, mid-, or long-range weapon builds tailored to different approaches to combat, while still leaving room for further customization and refinement.[/p][p]Progression also expands through Apex Attachments. These are specialized unlocks earned by fully progressing a weapon, introducing unique modifications that can significantly change how that weapon behaves in combat. Depending on the attachment, they can alter handling, firing behavior, tactical utility, stealth capability, or combat role, giving fully leveled weapons new ways to perform beyond standard Gunsmith customization. Alongside new weapons, Equipment, and Killstreaks available at launch, players can also enter Prestige at max Soldier Rank to earn exclusive rewards and continue progressing through additional ranks.[/p][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] introduces greater player choice through two Prestige paths: Classic Prestige and Regular Prestige. Classic Prestige delivers the traditional reset experience, relocking Create-a-Class progression in exchange for increased XP earn rates and access to exclusive Prestige rewards. For players who prefer to maintain their unlocked Loadouts, Regular Prestige allows progression to restart from Level 1 without resetting Create-a-Class content, offering a more flexible path forward while still rewarding continued progression, with its own set of Prestige rewards and progression milestones.[/p][h3]Additional Multiplayer Intel Incoming[/h3][p]Expect a more extensive look at all aspects of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Multiplayer in the days ahead via the “From the Ward” video series, followed up by a recap blog, including a deep dive into Multiplayer and gameplay systems covering movement and gunplay innovations, maps, modes, progression, and more in greater detail.[/p][p] [/p][h2]DMZ // Overview[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e8e003f50f3daf651c86df90c03ca8cbadc56de2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]DMZ is the definitive [i]Call of Duty[/i] extraction experience, a living combat arena where every deployment is a new story. Deploy solo or with a squad into a volatile conflict zone as an off-the-books asset tasked with recovering advanced military technology left in the wake of war. The conditions in the exclusion zone are always shifting, with changing weather, dynamic military objectives, and hostile forces moving throughout the zone.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a7d215c10ee72b03437fbf8f1d275ec1c068114d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Loot, fight, negotiate, betray, and extract with whatever you can carry. The harder you push, the harder the world pushes back. Every run is a risk, every encounter is a choice, and no two deployments play out the same way.[/p][h3]Additional DMZ Intel Incoming[/h3][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/73f3eeca662281a3f3d3b18c319c887ca30b36d6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You won’t have long to wait for more information on DMZ. Get your first look at DMZ on June 7, including additional details and gameplay-focused coverage.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Technology and Platforms[/h2][p]Every shot. Every moment. Every battle. [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] delivers the most immersive and technically advanced [i]Call of Duty[/i] ever built.[/p][h3]Gameplay-First Visuals at a New Level of Fidelity[/h3][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] delivers a major leap in visual quality built directly into moment-to-moment gameplay and precision-tuned combat. Industry-leading VFX, lighting, materials, and character rendering work together to make combat clearer, more immersive, and more impactful, from explosions, smoke, and atmospherics to character detail and readability in dense, high-action scenes, even on maps filled with lush foliage and teeming with enemy combatants.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9723dc60eb3c6ba34bc9539ca61a08d588a1c09f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Fully Optimized for Current-Gen Hardware and High-End PCs[/h3][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] is built natively for current-generation PC, enabling greater scale, density, responsiveness, and consistency across every mode. Players will experience larger combat spaces, more active worlds, clearer engagements, and more consistent moment-to-moment performance. This current-generation focus goes beyond visual fidelity, helping Campaign, Multiplayer, and DMZ feel fluid, more responsive, and built for the full scope of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i].[/p][p]·      [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] will launch on PC.[/p][p]·      You can digitally preorder Modern Warfare 4 now on PC.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b066f072f8a36c6f24d76e58410d1c8894386508.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]A Focus on PC[/h3][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] is built with a renewed focus on the PC community, with Infinity Ward and Beenox partnering to give players more ways to tune performance, visual fidelity, responsiveness, and customization on PC.[/p][p]·      PC-specific performance optimizations are designed to support a wide range of hardware, from players prioritizing high frame rates to those pushing maximum visual fidelity.[/p][p]·      Multiple upscaling and frame generation options give PC players more ways to balance image quality, performance, and responsiveness.[/p][p]·      Expanded graphics options give players more control over how the game looks, performs, and feels.[/p][p]·      For players who want to push visual fidelity, high-end PC options include DLSS 4.5 support, expanded real-time ray tracing across Campaign, Multiplayer, and DMZ, improved performance across ray-traced reflections, ambient occlusion, shadows, and volumetrics, and higher-fidelity VFX and volumetric settings.[/p][p]·      Competitive-focused settings help players prioritize high frame rates and responsiveness in the moment-to-moment fight.[/p][p]·      You can digitally prepurchase [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] now on PC via Steam.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Stay Frosty: Additional Intel Incoming[/h2][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b2395cb219133aa692f4295a5f11d55ca1972ebe.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Track the latest official [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] intel on the newsitems.author: kyled
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3703047/882f6398bbe0c283cb33d57a3c18160c5d5a9f00.png[/img]

In just a few short months, the finest Dota teams in the world will gather in Shanghai to battle for the Aegis of Champions in front of thousands of cheering fans. We've announced [url=https://www.dota2.com/newsentry/655981180194128453]the official team invitations[/url], and now we'd like to extend one to you. If you want to be one of those fans cheering live at the arena, it's time to get ready: ticket sales for The International 2026 kick off on June 10th at 2pm China Standard Time.

The in-arena action runs from August 20 - 23 at the SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center, with two ticket options available: single-day tickets for any day, or two-day bundles covering Thursday/Friday and Saturday/Sunday. All seating this year will be assigned, with no General Admission options available.

Ticket prices vary based on day and section, so check out the full chart of options below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/eeda1e52cc7d32f4c0db01e2ed4f7ff409a95c4f.png[/img]

There are two purchase paths this year: one for fans purchasing domestically within China, and another for purchasing internationally.

[h2]China Domestic Sales[/h2]
Chinese domestic ticket sales will be available through [url=https://m.damai.cn/shows/item.html?itemId=1052581844801]Damai[/url] or the Perfect World app, and will require a Chinese ID to complete any sale.

Once ticket sales begin on June 10th at 2pm (China Standard Time), the first twenty minutes will serve as a priority purchase period for domestic tickets. During this period, purchases are restricted to active Dota players in China who have played at least ten games in within the last six months. (To be eligible for priority purchase, please [url=https://www.dota2.com.cn/international/2026/ticketspriority]verify your account status[/url] in advance by the end of Wednesday, June 3, 2026.)

From 2:30pm (CST) onward, domestic tickets will be available for purchase to all Chinese customers.

[h2]International Sales[/h2]
For fans purchasing outside of China, ticket sales will commence on June 10th at 2:30pm (CST) via [url=https://www.trip.com/t/TI2026]Trip.com[/url].

[h1]FAQ[/h1]

[b]How does seating work?[/b]
Tickets are purchased for a specific seating region (see chart above). After your purchase, you will be assigned a specific seat in the region you selected. All seats are assigned and reserved. [i]There are no general admission tickets or seats.[/i]

[b]What is the ticket transfer policy?[/b]
Tickets cannot be transferred, gifted, or resold. Tickets can only be used by the names for which they were purchased.

[b]What do I need to purchase tickets internationally?[/b]
Trip.com requires an account and a valid passport for international ticket purchases. You can create your account and submit attendee documentation before tickets go on sale.

[b]Can I purchase tickets for my group?[/b]
Yes, but note that the ticketing platforms limit each individual account to a maximum of two tickets per day. Multiple transactions may be required depending on the size of your group and how many days you wish to attend. As noted above, each attendee/ticket holder must have proper identification in order to complete the checkout process.

[b]Do I need to bring anything else besides my tickets to enter the event?[/b]
Event entrance requires a valid photo ID matching the name on the ticket.

[b]What is the ticket refund policy?[/b]
For China domestic ticket sales, please see the [url=https://m.damai.cn/shows/item.html?itemId=1052581844801]Damai refund policy[/url]. For international ticket sales, please see the [url=https://www.trip.com/t/TI2026]Trip.com refund policy[/url].

newsitems.title: IEM Cologne 2026
newsitems.author: brianlev
newsitems.contents:
The IEM Cologne 2026 Major is fast approaching. Teams are making final adjustments, fine-tuning their strats, and crossing their fingers that they won't face Vitality until the Grand Final. That can only mean one thing: Tournament Items featuring Teams and Player Autographs are now available for purchase!

[h3]The 2026 Cologne Major Shop[/h3]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/8f7212f18c038fcecaa6c96cfeb9785f14d74489.png[/img]
The Major Shop has undergone some major renovation--now you can directly get any sticker you want (at prices set by demand). Holo Furia logo? You got it. Foil Donk autograph? No problem. 

You can purchase tokens and redeem them for any sticker you want. The prices of stickers will depend on relative demand (when lots of players buy a particular sticker, its price goes up and other sticker prices go down), but if you're worried that a sticker might drop in price right after you buy it, we've got you covered. If a sticker price drops by more than 25 tokens within 24 hours of your purchase you'll get a refund of tokens for the total difference.

Details about the Major Shop renovation and how this all works can be found in the FAQ below.

[h3]Souvenir-O-Matic[/h3]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/8b98a1ee99bd0178265c42624a4ee8d41ac91768.png[/img]
What will you bring to the signing session? Now you can craft your own Souvenir! Take any normal or Souvenir quality weapon in your inventory and select a completed match and one of the players. You'll get your weapon back in Souvenir quality with gold team, autograph, and map stickers applied.

[h3]Pick'Em[/h3]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/b50091a00523a82121c1e9707ca7a92276d21349.png[/img]
Purchase and activate a Cologne 2026 Viewer Pass, and you'll receive a 2026 Cologne Major Challenge Coin. Play the Pick'Em Challenge to upgrade your Challenge Coin from Bronze to Silver, Gold, or Diamond and with each upgrade you'll get 300 tokens that you can redeem for the stickers or souvenirs of your choice.

[h3]Supporting the Teams[/h3]
As with previous Majors, 50% of the tournament item sales are shared with the Tournament Organizer, Teams, and Players. But this time the royalty rates depend on performance. Between now and the end of the Major royalty rates for token sales are based on the teams' VRS seeding, and after the Major the royalty rates will be based on the Major final standings. The breakdown is in the FAQ, below.

So clear your schedule and tune in, as the Major returns to the Cathedral of Counter-Strike!

[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[h5]Q. Why aren't you selling capsules?[/h5]
In the past we shipped team and player autograph stickers in capsules. While this approach was popular, we've heard feedback that players might prefer to purchase stickers directly. Additionally, players in certain regions cannot purchase sticker capsules. So we're exploring alternatives that allow all players to participate.

[h5]Q. How do I get tournament items?[/h5]
Add any sticker or stickers you like to your cart, and check out. To complete your transaction, first you'll purchase and activate tokens, and then redeem those tokens for your sticker.

Sticker purchases are final and cannot be refunded. If you cancel your transaction before activating your tokens, those tokens _can_ be refunded. If you cancel your transaction after activating your tokens, the tokens will remain in your balance (and cannot be refunded) but you can redeem them for something else.

[h5]Q. How are sticker prices set?[/h5]
The prices of all stickers depend on relative demand. This means that if one sticker is purchased disproportionately more than another, its price will go up and the other sticker's price will go down. After a large number of stickers are sold, all sticker prices will update (you'll get a warning if you're shopping when this is about to happen). The prices in tokens you see are the same prices for everyone worldwide.

[h5]Q. Why do I have to purchase tokens?[/h5]
Tokens are a little less convenient than just paying for stickers outright. But the reality is that if stickers could be refunded after being purchased, then the sticker prices would not accurately represent real demand.

[h5]Q. Can I pre-purchase tokens?[/h5]
No. Tokens are only purchased when you're buying stickers and do not already have enough tokens in your balance. In that case, you'll be asked to purchase the exact number of tokens required (minimum 100, which is $0.99 USD) to complete your transaction.

[h5]Q. What if the sticker price goes down after I redeem my tokens?[/h5]
If the price of any redeemed sticker decreases by 25 tokens or more within the next 24 hours, we'll automatically issue you a refund of tokens for the difference between your redemption price and the lowest price in that period. Refunds are automatically credited to your tokens balance after one week.

[h5]Q. How do souvenirs work this time?[/h5]
Take any weapon of normal or souvenir quality in your inventory and select a completed match and one of the players from that match. You'll permanently convert that weapon into a Souvenir with gold team, autograph, and map stickers applied. You will have a chance to see a preview of your souvenir before you complete your purchase.

If the weapon had any existing stickers, they will be removed before you craft your souvenir.

[h5]Q. How are souvenir prices determined?[/h5]
Souvenir prices are determined by two factors: the demand for the specific gold team and autograph stickers involved, and the rarity of the weapon you choose for your souvenir.

[h5]Q. How are royalties shared among the tournament organizer, teams and players?[/h5]
50% of total Major Shop and Major Pass revenue is shared as royalties with the tournament organizer, teams, and players. The chart below shows how that 50% is distributed. Note that for each team position, half of the royalties are shared with the team organization, and the other half is split equally among the five players.

Between now and the grand final, royalties are shared based on the teams' global VRS leading into the event. After the grand final, royalties will be shared based on the final standings.
